_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman &amp; Nicobar Islands.
   1. The applicant should be engaged in any building &amp; other construction work.
   1. The applicant should be registered under the A&amp;N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The applicant should have an active membership of the Board.
   1. The son or daughter of the applicant/registered worker should be enrolled in any grade from Class I to Post Graduate Level/Professional Course.
